cases.subject: FPSFA 2.10.9 Drinking Water (Purified)
cases.original_law_fact: FSSAI 2019 First Amendment inserted standalone 2.10.9 for water offered/sold through decentralised vending machines, other than packaged drinking and natural mineral water, excluding captive water; requires clarity and compliance with IS:10500.
cases.prohibited_transfer: Neither packaged drinking-water CTR lead 0.01 mg/L nor 2025 draft purified-water lead 0.01 mg/L is automatically established for the sold vending product. Do not use the draft as operative legislation.
cases.next_original_evidence: Document actual vended non-captive product, valid IS 10500 edition and applicability, original 2019 Gazette plus any enacted updates replacing it, precise approved water-lead analytical requirement and recognised laboratory matrix/lots.
cases.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine

cases.subject: FPSFA 2.4.11(4) Formulated supplements for children
cases.original_law_fact: 2018 Gazette created formulated supplements for children standard applying above 24 months through 36 months. Current 2025 FSSAI chapter retains that narrow age scope. Nutrient-source reference to infant foods and follow-up-formula microbiology do not convert products into the CTR infant-food lead row.
cases.prohibited_transfer: Do not apply infant milk substitute or infant food lead comparator to the 24–36 month supplement by mere age/nutrition-reference analogy.
cases.next_original_evidence: Actual marketed age and packaging; nutritional composition/BOM, product use instructions; effective original CTR food lead article, selected accredited lead/matrix method and signed representative lot CoA.

cases.subject: FoSCoS Category 11.6 generic permitted polyols
cases.original_law_fact: FoSCoS lists permitted polyols excluding already standardized ones as a pooled category. FSSAI CTR IX 2.1.1 Nickel table expressly names Sorbitol at 2.0 mg/kg, not the broad polyols category.
cases.source_specific_age_or_substance: CTR nickel comparator: Sorbitol only, 2.0 mg/kg
cases.prohibited_transfer: Never apply the sorbitol nickel value to an unnamed or differently specified polyol; named INS/CAS composition and exact operative legal substance must be supplied.
cases.next_original_evidence: Supplier ingredient name/CAS/INS, controlled grade and purity standard, source monograph, signed original nickel provision and laboratory verified analyte/matrix scope with actual CoA.
cases.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
